sources.finding: Architect portfolio confirms adaptive reuse of the former Southwest Fisheries building and new construction. Visible gallery links were examined but image fetches returned cache misses; no numbered floor plan was obtained.

Official annual report locates the new Visualization Lab on the second floor. Its 20 by 7 foot measurement is the screen size, not a classroom boundary or room size. No 202/210 room identity crosswalk.
Official report says the Kwok Innovation Kitchen was completed in July 2025. No target-room floor plan is shown by the retrieved page content.
Secondary bid listing identifies a second-floor room 207 kitchen build-out and lists 75 plans behind subscription. Documents were not accessed. Room 207 is not any of the four requested keys.
Normal browser navigation redirects to the owner planroom login page. No drawings downloaded; login/planroom membership unresolved. Potential neighboring-room drawing coverage remains unverified.

limitations: The existing 2019 Coastal Commission exhibits are site and elevation sheets, not current numbered room plans.
A 2025 kitchen fit-out and a display in another room do not establish the dimensions of 202 or 210.
